gates.requirement: Exact VADToolkit/AMI source revisions, commands, audio/annotation assets, hashes, byte counts, and manifests are pinned and present.

A pinned reference scoring run is reproduced on frozen inputs with hashed outputs and verified parity/tolerance policy.

Any future SDK adapter is optional, task-local/dev-evidence only, preserves installed v0 behavior, and is not exposed as a processor.
